title: NSF Gulfstream V surveys over the triangle

tellings.quote: when you've got the National Science Foundation's $50 million Gulfstream 5 jet

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for strange reports, says that a $50 million Gulfstream V jet belonging to the National Science Foundation, the US government's science funding agency, flew over a part of the ranch called the triangle. The owner tells this as a witness, speaking to Jesse Michels, and offers it as a sign of how seriously the place is being studied.
